Title: Public Preview: Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus now supports querying PromQL

Body.Content:
With Azure Workbooks support for Azure Monitor managed service Prometheus, users can use our out of box Prometheus explorer workbook to run PromQL queries in the portal.

In addition, users get the benefit of creating their own custom Prometheus workbook reports. Azure workbooks provide numerous, rich visualizations such as:

  • Text parameters
  • Using queries:
    • Charts
    • Grids
    • Tiles
    • Trees
    • Honeycomb
    • Graphs
    • Maps
    • Text visualization

Learn how to query Prometheus with Azure workbooks docs: https://aka.ms/promqlworkbooks. 

Pricing comparison: https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/monitor/
